cd /work && openscad -o /tmp/lid.stl model.scad -D 'part="lid"' 2>&1 | tail -3; ls -la /tmp/lid.stl
python3 << 'EOF'
import trimesh, numpy as np
m = trimesh.load('/tmp/lid.stl')
print("bounds", m.bounds)
# per-face analysis: find faces with normal.z < -cos(45) i.e. overhang >45deg from vertical
# overhang measured from vertical: faces pointing down-ish
n = m.face_normals; c = m.triangles_center
down = -n[:,2]  # 1 = pointing straight down
# overhang faces: angle from +Z > 135? Let's just bucket "down-facing" (n_z < -0.707 means within 45 of straight down -> flat ceiling)
import collections
flat = (n[:,2] < -np.cos(np.radians(1)))  # within 1 deg of horizontal downward
print("flat ceiling faces:", flat.sum(), "area:", m.area_faces[flat].sum())
cc = c[flat]
print("z values:", np.unique(np.round(cc[:,2],2)))
print("x range:", cc[:,0].min(), cc[:,0].max(), "y range:", cc[:,1].min(), cc[:,1].max())
# group by z
for z in np.unique(np.round(cc[:,2],2)):
    sel = np.abs(cc[:,2]-z)<0.01
    pts = cc[sel]
    print(f" z={z}: n={sel.sum()} area={m.area_faces[flat][sel].sum():.1f} x:[{pts[:,0].min():.1f},{pts[:,0].max():.1f}] y:[{pts[:,1].min():.1f},{pts[:,1].max():.1f}]")
EOF
